sections.heading: MINOR IN INTERCULTURAL COMMUNICATION FOR ARABIC - admission discontinued
lines: Faculty of Arts and Humanities - Languages, Cultures, and Linguistics

Admission to this module is discontinued effective September 1, 2026. Students currently enrolled in the module will be permitted to graduate upon fulfillment of the module requirements by August 31, 2029.
Completion of first-year requirements, including Arabic 1030 or Arabic 1035 with a mark of at least 60% or permission of the Department.
0.5 course from: Intercultural Communications 3300F/G/Z, Intercultural Communications 3600F/G/Z, Intercultural Communications 3800F/G/Z.

1.5 courses from: Anthropology 2219A/B, Arabic 3300, History 2162A/B, History 2606E, History 2608F/G, Intercultural Communications 3300F/G/Z, Intercultural Communications 3600F/G/Z, Intercultural Communications 3800F/G/Z (not selected above).
